svg.title: How Redpact works
svg.desc: Most development happens with you and Codex or Claude Code. Agents communicate with Redpact over MCP and display MCP Apps UI in the agent client. Redpact manages test environments and execution, and provides a review UI for diffs, test results and screenshots. Git, Testcontainers, Vitest and Playwright support these capabilities. Human feedback returns to the agent development loop.

text.tspan: Build with your agent. Review with Redpact.
